messages:
Anya: quick postmortem follow-up on the noise spike  mapped recurring pages and sketched a small remediation plan. attaching heatmap: https://internal.redwood/pm/noise. :mag:
Rafael: thanks. what's the top thing to tackle this sprint?
Anya: top priority = api-auth-timeout flapping (lots of duplicates). 2) kvcache bursts, 3) model-infer transient OOMs. I'll propose owners.
Jules: I can take api-auth-timeout. plan: move threshold from 95th->99.5th with 3m hysteresis and add a non-pager soft alert for context. ETA PR by Thu.
Anya: for kvcache I recommend a conservative dedupe window + allow_urgent gate. sample snippet:
```
policy: kvcache-dedupe-experiment
group_by: request_prefix
window: 3m
max_pages: 1
allow_urgent_if: error_rate > 0.2
```
Jules: safe. add a dashboard tile for suppression_rate and missed_alert_estimate.
Rafael: i'll own model OOM mitigations  short-term mem bump + soft-oom non-pager for 48h. will file infra ticket and link it.
triage-bot: Created INF-5200 "api-auth threshold + soft-alert" assigned to Jules, due 2026-04-09.
Anya: owners recap & deadlines: Jules (auth thresholds) Thu, Rafael (model OOM mitigation) Fri, Anya (kvcache dedupe canary) Mon. weekly follow-up set: Wed 10:00 20m.
Jules: will include rollback criteria in PR: if missed_alert_estimate >= 0.01 for 30m -> rollback + page infra-oncall.
Anya: perfect. I'll update the postmortem action sheet and add calendar invite. ping me if blockers. :white_check_mark:
